I’ll retrieve the paper’s PDF text directly and check the equation/result around the fish-bag volume.
```python
paper_pdf = await web_fetch("https://journals.le.ac.uk/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684/1496", max_chars=20000)
print(paper_pdf)
```
The direct fetch did not expose the PDF text sufficiently; I’ll search the exact equation fragment to identify the final volume stated in the paper.
```python
equation_search = await web_search('"0.1777" "fish" "bag" Hiccup', max_results=10)
print(equation_search)
```
I’ll use the paper’s indexed equation snippet and retrieve the surrounding search text for the final numerical result.
```python
paper_result_search = await web_search('"equal to the total volume of the bag from Eq. (4)"', max_results=10)
print(paper_result_search)
```
0.1777 m³
